title: chrysojasminum humile f. farreri
intro: Chrysojasminum humile f. farreri, commonly known as the Golden Jasmine or Chinese Star Jasmine, is a climbing plant native to China, belonging to the Oleaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Chrysojasminum humile f. farreri are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which are achieved through its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as jasminoidin and jasminol, have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, contributing to its overall therapeutic efficacy.
